items.title: Energy crisis, economic stress to take two years to ease
items.description: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury expects the energy crisis and broader economic pressures facing Bangladesh to stabilise within two years, with a full economic recovery taking up to five years.
